description: This Java class defines a PresentationMessage object used for representing user-facing messages with associated locale and metadata within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: PresentationMessage
classes.description: A model class representing a message intended for presentation to a user, including metadata such as code, locale, description, and message text.

methods.name: PresentationMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the PresentationMessage object with specified values.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the look-up key for the message.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the look-up key for the message.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the locale associated with the message.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the message.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the message.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the text content of the message.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the message, indicating its meaning or use.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the message.
